# Single-Agent Exception Policy

Status: active
Owner: orchestrator governance
Version: 1.0.0

Reference source:
- .github/agents/orchestrator.md (Single-Agent Exception Policy)

## Baseline rule
- Multi-agent delegation is default.
- Orchestrator-only path is exception and must be justified.

## Mandatory exception controls
- exception_reason
- confidence delta vs multi-agent route
- follow-up revalidation or explicit closure rationale
- prohibition for unresolved compliance-heavy blockers
